title: ​Securing AI-native Commerce Without Breaking the Cart - James Wickett & Adam Dyche
description: ​AI agents are shopping, checking out, and moving money…fast. Adam Dyche (Commerce) and James Wickett (DryRun Security) will show how the OWASP LLM Top 10 applies to agentic checkout, from prompt injection in product reviews to excessive agency across tools. It'll cover risks relevant to consider for any LLM application, as well as the architectural, process, and technical options.
